## 🤖 Bot Telegram : la télécommande de ta recherche
**Routeur** → analyse chaque message, commande ou clic sur un bouton, puis l'aiguille vers la bonne branche :
- 🗄️ **Commandes base de données** : /offres, /offre_12, /chercher, /candidatures, /stats, /recherches…
- ✍️ **Lettre** : /lettre_12 ou bouton → sous-workflow 04
- 🧠 **IA** : /entretien_12 (préparation d'entretien) ou question libre (coach carrière)
- 📥 **Import** : colle le lien d'une offre trouvée ailleurs → extraction IA + analyse
- 📄 **CV** : envoie ton CV en PDF → ton profil est mis à jour automatiquement

🔒 Seul ton compte (TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID) peut piloter le bot.

SELECT row_to_json(p) AS profile,
  (SELECT row_to_json(j) FROM (
     SELECT id, title, company, location, contract_type, description, summary,
            key_skills, strengths, gaps, missing_skills
     FROM jobs WHERE id = $1::int) j) AS job,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(status, total), '{}') FROM v_pipeline) AS pipeline,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT id, title, company, score, status FROM jobs
     WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'ignored'
     ORDER BY collected_at DESC, score DESC LIMIT 15) t) AS recent_jobs,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(skill), '[]') FROM (SELECT skill FROM v_missing_skills LIMIT 8) t) AS missing_skills
FROM profile p WHERE p.id = 1;

INSERT INTO jobs (source, external_id, url, title, company, location, contract_type, salary, description, published_at)
SELECT source, external_id, url, title, company, location, contract_type, salary, description, published_at
FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::jobs, $1::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title, company = EXCLUDED.company, location = EXCLUDED.location,
  contract_type = EXCLUDED.contract_type, salary = EXCLUDED.salary, description = EXCLUDED.description
RETURNING id, title, company, (xmax = 0) AS created;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS x(
    full_name text, headline text, cv_text text, target_roles text[], skills text[],
    languages text[], locations text[], years_experience int)
)
UPDATE profile p SET
  full_name        = COALESCE(d.full_name, p.full_name),
  headline         = COALESCE(d.headline, p.headline),
  cv_text          = d.cv_text,
  target_roles     = CASE WHEN cardinality(d.target_roles) > 0 THEN d.target_roles ELSE p.target_roles END,
  skills           = CASE WHEN cardinality(d.skills) > 0 THEN d.skills ELSE p.skills END,
  languages        = CASE WHEN cardinality(d.languages) > 0 THEN d.languages ELSE p.languages END,
  locations        = CASE WHEN cardinality(p.locations) > 0 THEN p.locations ELSE d.locations END,
  years_experience = COALESCE(d.years_experience, p.years_experience),
  updated_at       = now()
FROM d
WHERE p.id = 1
RETURNING p.full_name, p.headline, p.target_roles, p.skills, p.years_experience;
